1.21.1.3.0.1: Deeper Down 3.0.1: works with FoxTrot 4.0 (the dungeon music pauses while you play a FoxTrot song again). Needs FoxTrot 4.0 or newer if you have FoxTrot.
1.21.1.3.0.0: Deeper Down 3.0.0: the dungeon is its own mod now. Works on its own (craft a Descent), with Cobblemon (party battles) or with PokéShift (as before). Pit and lava rooms are parkour-or-die if you're not the type they're for.
